rep.angle: lead with a recent hiring push you noticed
rep.name: Sara

turns.speaker: buyer
turns.text: Sam Whitfield. I have fifteen minutes, go ahead.

turns.speaker: rep
turns.text: Sam, thanks. I noticed Northwind’s recent sales hiring push. How are you ensuring those new reps are ready before they speak with buyers?

turns.speaker: buyer
turns.text: We spent sixty thousand dollars on training last year and saw no change in win rate. Why is this worth forty-eight thousand dollars?

turns.speaker: rep
turns.text: Fair concern. Unlike one-off training, HyperSale shows weekly improvement with quote-backed scoring; where did last year’s program fail—practice, manager visibility, or adoption?

turns.speaker: buyer
turns.text: Adoption was inconsistent, managers couldn’t quantify progress, and win rate stayed flat. How many weeks will this cut from ramp time, and what is the dollar value for forty reps?

turns.speaker: rep
turns.text: I can quantify it, but not honestly without your current ramp time and first-year rep productivity. What are those today?

turns.speaker: buyer
turns.text: Six months to full productivity, and first-year reps average 55% of quota. Quantify the annual value, then explain why I should pay forty-eight thousand instead of thirty-five.

turns.speaker: rep
turns.text: What’s annual quota per rep? If HyperSale cuts two weeks, that’s 1/26 of quota capacity per rep; $48,000 covers 40, while $35,000 means reduced scope.

turns.speaker: buyer
turns.text: Annual quota is $1.2 million per rep. Use the 55% first-year attainment in your calculation, and tell me what you can do on price—I have a $35,000 ceiling.

turns.speaker: rep
turns.text: At 55%, two weeks across 40 reps represent $1.02 million in quota capacity. At $35,000, we’d reduce scope; let’s review business-case and pilot options.

turns.speaker: buyer
turns.text: Quota capacity isn’t booked revenue. What exact scope can you offer at $35,000, and what date do you propose to review the business case with my VP of Sales?

turns.speaker: rep
turns.text: At $35,000: 32 reps for 12 months, with AI roleplays, quote-backed scoring, and manager dashboards. Can we review with your VP Tuesday, November 3?

turns.speaker: buyer
turns.text: Tuesday, November 3 works; include my VP and an option covering all 40 reps at $35,000, with the two-week ramp claim translated into booked revenue. Send me the business case and we'll take it from there.
